rubric.description: A heuristic author judgment about implementation breadth and integration within each axis and its declared scope. These ordinal anchors are not equal-interval measurements, calibrated capability scores, probabilities or scientific acceptance thresholds.
rubric.assignmentNote: The incoming values and rationales are preserved verbatim. This rubric declares how the provisional overlay is to be read; the imported values have not been recomputed or independently rated against its anchors. Decimal values indicate author interpolation only, not measurement precision.

anchors.label: No implementation identified
anchors.definition: The author judges that no relevant implementation is present in the inspected scope. Missing evidence alone does not justify zero.

anchors.label: Illustrative component
anchors.definition: An isolated demonstration or component suggests the construct, with little integration into the operating system.

anchors.label: Partial implementation
anchors.definition: Some relevant mechanisms operate, but major parts of the declared construct or integration remain absent or restricted.

anchors.label: Bounded working implementation
anchors.definition: Relevant mechanisms function together in a limited setting; broader behavior, coverage or acceptance evidence remains incomplete.

anchors.label: Substantial integrated implementation
anchors.definition: Multiple relevant mechanisms or behaviors are substantially integrated in the inspected scope, while material limitations remain.

anchors.label: Extensive implementation in declared scope
anchors.definition: The author judges implementation breadth and integration to be extensive within the declared scope. This is not a claim of scientific validation, unlimited generality or human-level ability.

limitations: All 25 values are provisional author estimates, not measured protocol results. Imported rationales may contain unverified interpretation or numerical claims and await independent review.
The original evidence review remains dated 2026-10-21 at the pinned commit. Recording these estimates on 2026-10-22 is not a new execution or review of the canonical acceptance protocols.
Different axes concern different constructs and units of analysis. Values are not calibrated across axes or systems, so no overall score, domain mean, ranking or uncertainty interval is published.

Engineering estimates describe implementation context only. No value is a probability or verdict of consciousness, sentience, AGI or superintelligence, and theory-linked implementation does not establish experience.
Canonical assessment.score remains null for all 25 axes. Missing measurements remain unknown; not-applicable requires an explicit subject and scope reason.
